title: Fixed Stave-Basket Screw Press
description: One newly authored whole static farm fruit-press appearance: two timber uprights and a thick truly bored top crossbeam carry a fixed vertical spindle with visible coarse helical thread and a transverse wood handle. A separate round pressure platen lies inside a genuinely open slatted stave basket held by two full annular hoops. Below it a shallow collector floor, partial raised rim and connected open U spout form a visible unfilled tray on the grounded timber base. Complete new construction, not a resized closed barrel, nested textile basket, flat-jaw bench vise or lever citrus press. No old visible meshes are imported or extracted. Closed editable meshes and three opaque constant PBR materials; small fixed embedded junctions. Metres, Z up and actual whole horizontal bounds centre, base underside Z0. Empty static game-art only: no fruit, liquid, pressing stroke, thread engagement, pressure, juice yield, food contact/hygiene, manufacture, stability or real-equipment safety certification.
